d:
Lok aastha ke mahaparv chhath ko lekar bihar men utsah aur umang ka mahaul hai. chhath ke paranprik giton ke bina is parv ki kalpana adhuri lagti hai. in giton men jahan lok sanskriti, paranpra aur aastha ki jhalak milti hai, vahin samaj ko ekjut karne ka sandesh bhi chhipa hota hai. big bos phem aur bhojpuri gayak dipak thakur ne bhi is bar chhath parv ko lekar nae git pesh kie hain. unhonne chhath ki mahatta, sharda sinha ke giton se apne jurav aur samajik samanta ke sandesh par khulkar bat ki. is dauran unhonne chhath ke tin git bhi gakar sunae
